title: Open Trivia DB — Disney Films
description: Crowd-sourced questions from opentdb.com, filtered for Disney content.

questions.prompt: What is the orange and white bot's name in "Star Wars: The Force Awakens"?
questions.explanation: BB-8 debuted in 2015's The Force Awakens; the on-set version was a practical rolling puppet partly operated by Brian Herring and Dave Chapman.

questions.prompt: In Mulan (1998), who is the leader of the Huns?
questions.explanation: Shan Yu, voiced by Miguel Ferrer, was animated by Pres Romanillos and designed with sharp angular features to contrast Mulan's softer lines.

questions.prompt: According to the Star Wars lore, what is Han Solo's home planet?
questions.explanation: Corellia is an industrial shipbuilding world featured prominently in 2018's Solo: A Star Wars Story, where a young Han escapes the planet's slums.

questions.prompt: Which actor plays Obi-Wan Kenobi in Star Wars Episodes I-III?
questions.explanation: Ewan McGregor played young Obi-Wan in the prequels (1999-2005) and reprised the role for the Disney+ series Obi-Wan Kenobi in 2022.

questions.prompt: What character in the Winnie the Pooh films was added by Disney and does not appear in the original books?
questions.explanation: Gopher was created for Disney's 1966 short Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree; he even quips 'I'm not in the book' on first appearance.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the first "Star Wars" film by release order?
questions.explanation: The 1977 film was originally titled just 'Star Wars'; the subtitle 'Episode IV: A New Hope' was added to the opening crawl for the 1981 re-release.

questions.prompt: When does "Rogue One: A Star Wars Story" take place chronologically in the series?
questions.explanation: Rogue One (2016) ends mere minutes before A New Hope begins, depicting the Rebel mission to steal the Death Star plans.

questions.prompt: Which town is the setting for the Disney movie The Love Bug (1968)?
questions.explanation: The Love Bug introduced Herbie, a sentient 1963 Volkswagen Beetle racing through San Francisco; it was the highest-grossing film of 1969.

questions.prompt: In Avengers: Infinity War, where was the Soul Stone located?
questions.explanation: Vormir is a desolate planet where Red Skull guards the Soul Stone; Thanos sacrifices Gamora there to claim it.

questions.prompt: Which movie sequel had improved box office results compared to its original film?
questions.explanation: Toy Story 2 (1999) earned about $497M worldwide versus the original's $373M, and was almost scrapped when an accidental command nearly deleted it from Pixar's servers.

questions.prompt: In Finding Nemo, what was the name of Nemo's mom?
questions.explanation: Coral is killed by a barracuda in the opening scene of Finding Nemo (2003), leaving Marlin to raise Nemo alone.

questions.prompt: What was the first feature-length computer-animated movie?
questions.explanation: Pixar's Toy Story (1995), directed by John Lasseter, was the first fully CGI feature film and took roughly four years to produce.

questions.prompt: Which Marvel superhero did Chris Evans play prior to his role as Captain America?
questions.explanation: Chris Evans played Johnny Storm in 2005's Fantastic Four and its 2007 sequel before becoming Steve Rogers in 2011's Captain America: The First Avenger.

questions.prompt: Who portrayed Han Solo in the Star Wars main film series?
questions.explanation: Harrison Ford was working as a carpenter at Lucasfilm when he was cast as Han Solo in 1977's Star Wars; he returned for The Force Awakens in 2015.

questions.prompt: What is the oldest Disney film?
questions.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
questions.explanation: Snow White (1937) was Walt's first feature, dubbed 'Disney's Folly' by Hollywood until it became the highest-grossing film of all time at release.

questions.prompt: Which of these Disney classics was released in 1970?
questions.explanation: The Aristocats was the first animated feature greenlit after Walt Disney's death and the last one he personally approved before he died in 1966.

questions.prompt: The 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana' is based on which culture?
questions.explanation: Moana draws on Polynesian mythology — including the demigod Maui — and Disney convened an Oceanic Story Trust of Pacific Islander cultural advisors.

questions.prompt: Which actor auditioned for the role of Luke Skywalker?
questions.explanation: Kurt Russell was a serious contender for Luke before Mark Hamill landed the role; Russell turned down the casting offer to pursue dramatic roles.
